ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens with dark green and purple-red leaves, thin orange shredded carrot strands, and a few dark purple shreds, slightly glossy with light dressing, piled in a loose mound on the left side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate's area, about 8 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Grilled chicken-like piece with golden-brown charred edges and pale cream interior, firm but juicy, cut into a thick slab about 6 x 4 cm and 2.5 cm tall, sitting at the bottom center of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Shredded dark brown meat with crisp browned edges and some pale fibrous strands, slightly glossy and moist, scattered in a loose heap about 7 x 5 cm and 2 cm tall to the right of the sliced piece | 80
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slight yellow tint, firm and dry-looking with small bumpy surfaces, three large florets plus a smaller one, each about 3-4 cm across, clustered at the upper right of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Small brown fried or caramelized fragment with crumbly edges, sitting at the lower right edge beside the shredded meat, about 2 x 1.5 cm and 1 cm tall | 10
